title: The Grateful Dead Live at The Matrix on 1970-07-30
source: MR(Abrams)>R@ 7.5 ips.(Peter Kafer)>R @ 7.5 ips.(Will Boswell) > CD; Transfered and mastered by Matt Smith 5/11; cd > flac dbpoweramp cd ripper

ai_review.summary: Soundboard capture of a vibrant Gospel‑era acoustic set, but marred by noticeable hiss and generational noise.
ai_review.review: Reviewers rave about the short acoustic/gospel segment and the New Riders of the Purple Sage guests, calling it one of their favorite moments. The recording itself is a soundboard source that suffers from a high level of hiss and clutter, making the Cotsman remaster a preferable alternative for audiophiles.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong praise for the performance offsets the poor technical quality; with limited detailed feedback, a moderate rating and confidence are appropriate.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Noticeable hiss and noise from multiple generations of transfer; overall clarity is compromised compared to better remasters.

show_quality.setlist_flow: A brief, highly regarded acoustic set featuring gospel numbers and a New Riders of the Purple Sage segment with Garcia and Mickey Hart; the flow is praised for its intimacy despite its short length.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia’s presence in the New Riders segment is highlighted positively.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey Hart receives a nod for his drumming on the New Riders portion.
